name: hero-ai-value-proposition
title: Hero AI Value Proposition
description: A light landing hero with a centred two-line headline, short pitch, one black call to action and a row of designer faces. A product mockup of a brief builder rises beneath it.
use: A design or AI tool page wants a calm light hero with social proof and a product preview.
avoid: The preview is decorative placeholder bars, and all copy plus 78 colours are fixed in the JSX.
a11y: The four project-type tiles are clickable divs with no role or tab stop, and the reveal ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-white page boxed by thin grey rules. Two heavy lines of black type sit above a grey paragraph and a black pill button; beneath are five overlapping round portraits and a small blue count pill. A wide white card with a soft shadow rises at the bottom, showing a brief-builder screen with placeholder bars.
behaves: As the page scrolls into view the header, headline, paragraph, button and each avatar fade in one after another. The mockup then rises into place, revealing its selected 'Web app' tile with a pointer cursor; unselected tiles stay greyed and colour on hover.
customise: All copy, avatar photos and the mockup markup sit in the JSX; only colours on the cards and glows can be changed in place.
weight: light: One staggered reveal of text and images; nothing animates after it settles.
demo: Headline 'AI-generated project briefs built for designers', 'Join 80,000+ designers' and a brief-builder mockup.
issues: Project-type tiles are plain divs, so keyboard users cannot reach them.
The product preview is filled with grey placeholder bars, not real text.
Avatar images carry empty alt text.
polishWhy: Crisp editorial grid and a believable product preview; the placeholder bars are thin.
